text: まどの　むこうには　……　とてもきれいな　そらが　みえる！

structure.jp: まどの　むこうには
とてもきれいな　そらが　みえる！
structure.en: a very beautiful sky can be seen!

patterns.name: 〜が見える
patterns.explanation: みえる says something comes into view by itself, without you trying to look; the thing seen takes が. そらが みえる = 'the sky can be seen'.

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: に gives the place, and は adds 'as for that place', setting the scene for what follows. まどの むこうには = 'beyond the window'.

patterns.name: 〜な (na-adjective)
patterns.explanation: Describing words like きれい need な before the thing they describe. きれいな そら = 'a beautiful sky'.
